A payment service purpose may name only a uniquely matching already trusted service event with the source worker, employer and kind; retain ambiguity as unread. plan_purpose applies only to an actual source-established plan event. Complete null means the property was checked and absent.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
